request.query: Finsupp weight natural weights cast field common denominator division

items.name: Finsupp.weight_apply
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i

items.name: Rat.cast_finsupp_sum
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} {R : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] (f : α →₀ M) [inst_1 : DivisionRing R] [CharZero R]
  (g : α → M → ℚ), ↑(f.sum g) = f.sum fun a b => ↑(g a b)

items.name: Finsupp.weight_single
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (s : σ) (r : R), (Finsupp.weight w) (Finsupp.single s r) = r • w s
